description: Source code for the DailyWorkSummary document in ERPNext, including methods for sending emails, generating summaries, and handling user and communication data.

classes.name: DailyWorkSummary
classes.description: Represents a daily work summary document with methods to send emails, generate message details, and manage communication data.

methods.name: send_mails
methods.description: Sends emails with the daily work summary to specified users.

methods.name: send_summary
methods.description: Sends a summary of all replies, typically called at midnight.

methods.name: get_message_details
methods.description: Generates and returns message details, including replies and users who did not reply.
